scope: Independent occurrence and measurement HTTP acceptance against an isolated production process
checks: A manually imported recurring fixture has three stable dates and requires publication review
Date selection is exact and date filters choose an occurrence before parent pagination
Persisted date IDs cannot be removed or renamed and invalid transitions leave the reviewed record unchanged
Consented profiles retain default-off measurement and signed role boundaries
Saves and handoffs are independently idempotent for two dates and reject forged references
Reminders and factual reports retain exact dates and one dismissal cannot suppress its sibling
Reviewed rescheduling updates only its pending occurrence and stale edits conflict
Cancelling the primary date preserves reviewed active siblings and exact unavailable saves
Full-interval matching selects the second date once and source pause suppresses the series
Measurement, attribution and campaign APIs enforce the signed role and mutation boundaries
Default-off measurement does not track reads, unconsented recommendations or campaign visits
Explicit measurement consent and valid first touch persist without accepting arbitrary campaigns
A presentation request is uncounted until acknowledgement; forged, foreign and stale tokens fail
Acknowledged exposure preserves exact occurrence references and repeated acknowledgements are idempotent
Relevance is private, exact, owner-bound, retry-safe and independent of application state
Self-reported application after exposure stays measured after later withdrawal
Historical shown choices accept negative feedback after withdrawal but reject stale positive confirmation
Empty presentations are acknowledged as seekers without inventing a recipient or relevance response
Live measurement suppresses both small cohorts and complementary cells without leaking private rows
Campaign pause is versioned, blocks new attribution and preserves earlier first touch
Process restart preserves occurrence IDs, measurement consent, exposures and first-touch attribution
Measurement opt-out purges its records, stops collection and preserves ordinary student state
Profile deletion purges occurrence and measurement state for only its signed owner
limitations: Legacy migration is exercised by repository tests; no power-loss or backup recovery claim.
